Reference sheet: A vertical four-panel anime sports storyboard set in a bright outdoor soccer stadium. The main character is a determined teenage boy with short black hair, sharp eyes, and a red zip-up sports jacket with white stripes, white shorts, red socks, and athletic shoes. The opponent is a teenage boy with messy black hair, a white shirt, dark blue pants, and a red waistband. The setting includes a green soccer field, a red running track, stadium stands, distant school buildings, trees, and a bright blue sky. The visual style is classic shonen sports anime with bold outlines, vivid colors, dramatic speed lines, impact effects, and manga-style energy.

Generated video: Create an approximately 10-second anime action sequence with exactly four shots, following the storyboard order and no extra shots.

Shot 1: Medium close-up of the boy in the red jacket facing camera on the soccer field, both fists raised in front of his chest, posture tense and confident. The camera makes a slight push-in. His expression is determined and serious. He says in Chinese with a firm, energetic tone: “上吧！今天一定要赢！” Subtle wind moves his jacket, and the stadium background remains visible.

Shot 2: Dynamic wide action shot on the field. The boy in red launches a fast, powerful kick toward the opponent. The opponent reacts too slowly and is caught off guard. Strong lateral motion blur and dense speed lines emphasize the force and speed. The camera tracks the movement from left to right. The boy shouts in Chinese with a sharp, taunting tone: “太慢了！”

Shot 3: Dramatic medium close-up focused on the boy in red from the waist up as he drives one fist forward. His fist is surrounded by swirling golden fire-like energy, with explosive manga-style glow and circular impact effects. The camera slightly shakes and pushes closer to heighten intensity. He yells in Chinese with maximum force and passion: “燃烧吧！火焰冲击！”

Shot 4: Wide aftermath shot. The opponent crashes backward into the grass with dirt and debris bursting upward, while the boy in red stands upright a short distance away with hands on hips, breathing heavily. The camera holds a slightly low angle to emphasize victory, with dramatic speed lines still streaking through the sky behind him. His expression changes from fierce intensity to surprised disbelief. He says in Chinese with a breathless, confused tone: “我……我赢了？”

Natural outdoor daylight, crisp shadows, vivid anime color palette, expressive facial acting, strong action timing, and clear sound effects of footsteps, kick impact, fiery energy, and body hitting the ground. No background music.
